resources.string: To download torrents that contain folders to a USB drive or an SD card, Torrent TV needs the \"All files access\" permission. Without it, these torrents fail with \"Folder Permissions Needed\".
This device has no screen to grant this permission. From a computer, run:\n\nadb shell appops set %1$s MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow

Torrent TV is a torrent client for Android TV and phones: download in the living room and control it from your phone or computer.
